summary: The shipped ngspice testbenches/templates, their cold-start entry points (run_*.sh) and experiment READMEs are committed; every constituent hash matches the inventory and each README names its entry point. Testbenches are NOT re-run by this attestation and no measurement result is claimed.
verdict_semantics: pass = every file in the bound inventory exists and hashes to the recorded sha256, the inventory covers its completeness globs, and the content checks in signoff/evidence_inventory.py hold.
